item.text: The first six hours show $48.10 spent and 66 link clicks. Posts 2 and 3 have slightly lower costs per click, but the sample is too small to shift budget yet. I’ll keep the test running; these clicks do not establish which post produces more trial starts.

After the first day, X reports $209.17 spent and 327 link clicks. Posts 2 and 3 both cost about $0.62 per click, versus $0.69 for Post 1. I’m shifting some remaining budget toward them, with the largest allocation going to Post 2 because it also states the deadline and eligibility most clearly. The combined lifetime caps will stay at $650.

item.text: Six hours remain. X currently reports $560.08 spent and 940 link clicks, with Post 2 still delivering the lowest cost per click. I’ll keep the current allocation through the scheduled cutoff, then pause the campaign and collect the closing report.

The campaign ran January 6–8, 2027 in Dhaka time and is now paused.

- Spend: **$641.19** of $650
- Impressions: **1,115,844**
- Link clicks: **1,073**
- Average cost per link click: **$0.60**

I promoted only your approved posts and shifted budget toward stronger click performance.

These are X’s reported delivery figures and may still settle. Link clicks do not confirm visits or trial starts. Without trial tracking, trial starts and cost per trial remain unknown.
